summary: Outlook Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 29, 2026, disclosing a registered direct offering of 8,539,709 shares of common stock at $0.01 par value per share to GMS Ventures and Investments under a securities purchase agreement dated May 28, 2026. The offering was made under an existing effective S-3 registration statement. No pricing, premium, or other deal terms beyond share count and purchaser identity were disclosed. The company issued shares directly to a single investor. The filing is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for subsequent pricing disclosure and dilution impact.
